title: AWS access key ID
description: An AWS access key ID appears to be committed to the repository. Anyone with the matching secret key can act on the account.
remediation: Rotate the key immediately in IAM, remove it from the code and git history, and load credentials from the environment or a secrets manager.

title: GitHub token
description: A GitHub personal access or OAuth token appears to be committed to the repository.
remediation: Revoke the token at github.com/settings/tokens, purge it from git history, and pass it via environment variables or a CI secret store.

title: Private key material
description: A PEM private key block is present in the source tree. Private keys must never be committed.
remediation: Treat the key as compromised: revoke and reissue it, remove it from history, and store keys outside the repository with restrictive file permissions.

title: Slack webhook URL
description: A Slack incoming-webhook URL is hardcoded. Whoever has it can post into the workspace channel.
remediation: Rotate the webhook in the Slack app settings and inject it at deploy time instead of committing it.

title: Hardcoded credential assignment
description: A credential-looking value is assigned as a string literal. Generic pattern: verify whether the value is a real credential or a placeholder.
remediation: If real, rotate it and move it to an environment variable or secrets manager; if a placeholder, replace it with an obvious dummy value.
